quests.title: Disco in Motion, Holiday Emotion!

dialogue.t: Something like this... and like that... Those little thieves will be on their knees crying for mercy...
At a moment like this, if you "accidentally" let one of them slip away, He'll panic and run back to report it — and you just quietly tail him...
Then, right when they're busy planning their next move, you kick down the door to their hideout and give them the scare of a lifetime!
You make a very good point, Ms. Enghiene. When dealing with irredeemable criminals, unconventional methods are indeed necessary.
Natlan isn't like Fontaine, with all those convoluted... ahem, "elaborate law enforcement procedures"! I'll make good use of that advantage.
I already rounded up the remaining Saurian poachers earlier. I'll use your method and wipe out the smugglers to the north in one fell swoop.
And don't forget to give me the good news afterward. I'm really looking forward to it!
*sigh*... I'm no longer a member of the Maison Gardiennage. Under confidentiality regulations, Turenna can no longer report her work to me either.
Feels like I still have a few tricks I haven't shared with the people who could use them... Maybe I should just write a memoir?
Yes, a memoir sold exclusively to law enforcement all over the world! My 150 years of experience should be useful.
I'm all for it! Once you've fully enjoyed this party and feel nice and refreshed, writing it is sure to go smoothly too...
Then save me a signed copy!
You'll get the very first one! Once I've danced to my heart's content, I'll rent a typewriter as soon as I get back and start writing immediately!
A Melusine and... Nusta?
Now that's an unexpected combination. What are they talking about?

dialogue.sit: Sounds like they're talking about something pretty dangerous...?

dialogue.t: Alright! Our lead dancer is here — the great Tumaini! Let the party begin!
First things first — big news! Our second dance party is now underway!
And we've got new participants too: Ms. Enghiene from the Fontaine tour group, along with her three companions!
Also, thanks to our "Uthabiti," Kachina, and the idol from Mondstadt, the Fontaine guests and the Ashas here have all learned brand-new dance moves!
Wait, wait, wait... that's way too much information at once...
So besides everyone from before and the little Saurians, there are Melusines and... Ashas joining the stage too?
Exactly! Which means we get to dance to even more upbeat music and have even more fun!
As the lead dancer, you'll also get to show how well you can adapt to any rhythm!

dialogue.sit: The greater the hype, the better the vibe!

dialogue.t: Hold on, Nusta called you "Tumaini"... So you're THE Tumaini, {NICKNAME}?
The young warrior of the Children of Echoes who taught me to dance said her master is the great Tumaini of Natlan — and an amazing dancer too...
So after all that roundabout talk... it was you!

dialogue.sit: Then that makes me your grand-master, doesn't it?
Guess the Special Patrol Officer's intel network has limits too, huh?

dialogue.t: Pfft... guess Paimon's a grand-master too, then.
No way, no way! Why do I suddenly feel like I just dropped two ranks...?
Let's just each do our own ranking, okay?
Anyway, dancing really comes down to talent.
Who knows — maybe I'm one of those protagonist-level geniuses. Give me two days, and I'll be dancing just as well as you.
Not that we need to compete or anything. I just mean... whatever the beat, whatever the trendiest moves, I can always keep up!
Hehe, right! Dancing's all about having fun! Even if all you can do is sway to the beat, you're still part of it!
Looks like everything's ready?
If you want to catch up with friends first, they're all waiting for you over there!
Or we can gather everyone here anytime, get the music going, and kick off the main event!

quests.description: A courier from Natlan brings word inviting you and Paimon back to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort to take part in a one-of-a-kind “Dance Party”…
